decision.explanation: Document D1S1 explicitly states that Elia Kazan was the director of the film *Baby Doll*, noting that he wrote the majority of the screenplay. Document D3S3 also supports this claim by stating that Tennessee Williams' *Baby Doll* was adapted by director Elia Kazan. Document D2S1 mentions Elia Kazan directing *Baby Doll* as well, though it appears to conflate multiple works with similar titles. However, Document D4S1 clearly refers to a separate 1968 Italian film titled *Baby Doll* (also known as *La bambolona*), directed by Franco Giraldi. This is a distinct work and should not be conflated with the 1956 film *Baby Doll*. Therefore, only Elia Kazan is confirmed as the director of the 1956 film *Baby Doll*.
